cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
# This extension is intended to be added after the base LMX C99 collection.
# It never downloads sources while configuring or building.
set(_gfx_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")
set(_gfx_vendor "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}")
set(_gfx_view "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_gfx_view}")
option(LMX_GRAPHICS_BUILD_TESTS "Build headless graphics/image checks" ${BUILD_TESTING})
# Native window and GTK backends are excluded. Sokol supplies a real renderer
# using the selected graphics API SDK; the host owns context/device/presentation.

if(NOT COMMAND lmx_c99_target)
    function(lmx_c99_target target)
        set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
        if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
            target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
        endif()
    endfunction()
endif()

add_library(lmx_graphics INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::graphics ALIAS lmx_graphics)
function(_gfx_library name)
    add_library(lmx_graphics_${name} STATIC ${ARGN})
    add_library(LMX::${name} ALIAS lmx_graphics_${name})
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_graphics_${name})
    target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_${name} PUBLIC "${_gfx_root}/include")
    target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics INTERFACE lmx_graphics_${name})
endfunction()

_gfx_library(qoi "${_gfx_root}/src/qoi.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_qoi PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/qoi")

# Upstream explicitly supports compiling this .cpp as C; the copied .c keeps
# both the original filename/tree and a genuinely C-only toolchain.
configure_file("${_gfx_vendor}/lodepng/lodepng.cpp" "${_gfx_view}/lodepng.c" COPYONLY)
_gfx_library(lodepng "${_gfx_view}/lodepng.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_lodepng PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/lodepng")

_gfx_library(libspng "${_gfx_vendor}/libspng/spng/spng.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_libspng PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/libspng/spng")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_graphics_libspng PUBLIC SPNG_STATIC PRIVATE SPNG_DISABLE_OPT=1)
if(TARGET LMX::zlib)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_libspng PUBLIC LMX::zlib)
else()
    find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_libspng PUBLIC ZLIB::ZLIB)
endif()

_gfx_library(tpng "${_gfx_vendor}/tpng/tpng.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_tpng PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/tpng")

# Official R0.03 patch1 (2023-05-17) is applied only to a generated build copy.
file(READ "${_gfx_vendor}/tjpgdec/src/tjpgd.c" _gfx_tjpg)
string(REPLACE "R0.03                      " "R0.03 w/patch1             " _gfx_tjpg "${_gfx_tjpg}")
string(REPLACE "*pix++ = (uint8_t)*py++;" "if (JD_FASTDECODE >= 1) { *pix++ = BYTECLIP(*py++); } else { *pix++ = *py++; }" _gfx_tjpg "${_gfx_tjpg}")
file(WRITE "${_gfx_view}/tjpgd.c" "${_gfx_tjpg}")
_gfx_library(tjpgdec "${_gfx_view}/tjpgd.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_tjpgdec PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/tjpgdec/src")

_gfx_library(nanojpeg "${_gfx_vendor}/nanojpeg/nanojpeg.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_nanojpeg PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/nanojpeg")

_gfx_library(gifdec "${_gfx_vendor}/gifdec/gifdec.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_gifdec PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/gifdec")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_graphics_gifdec PRIVATE _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L)
_gfx_library(msf_gif "${_gfx_root}/src/msf_gif.c")
file(READ "${_gfx_vendor}/msf_gif/msf_gif.h" _gfx_msf)
string(REPLACE "268'435'456" "268435456" _gfx_msf "${_gfx_msf}")
file(WRITE "${_gfx_view}/msf_gif.h" "${_gfx_msf}")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_msf_gif PUBLIC "${_gfx_view}" "${_gfx_vendor}/msf_gif")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_graphics_msf_gif PRIVATE MSF_GIF_NO_SSE2)

_gfx_library(olive "${_gfx_root}/src/olive_impl.c")
add_library(LMX::olive_c ALIAS lmx_graphics_olive)
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_olive PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/olive")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_graphics_olive PUBLIC OLIVECDEF=)
_gfx_library(microui "${_gfx_vendor}/microui/src/microui.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_microui PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/microui/src")
include("${_gfx_root}/C99Views.cmake")
_gfx_library(nuklear "${_gfx_root}/src/nuklear.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_nuklear BEFORE PUBLIC "${_gfx_view}/nuklear")
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_nuklear PUBLIC "${_gfx_vendor}/nuklear")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_graphics_nuklear PUBLIC
    NK_INCLUDE_FIXED_TYPES NK_INCLUDE_STANDARD_IO NK_INCLUDE_STANDARD_VARARGS
    NK_INCLUDE_DEFAULT_ALLOCATOR NK_INCLUDE_VERTEX_BUFFER_OUTPUT
    NK_INCLUDE_FONT_BAKING NK_INCLUDE_DEFAULT_FONT)

# One real Sokol renderer implementation is selected per build. These are
# graphics API choices, not library enable/disable switches. No window backend
# (sokol_app/glue, X11, GLX, GTK) or real audio-device backend is compiled.
set(_gfx_sokol_default GLCORE)
if(ANDROID OR EMSCRIPTEN OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten" OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS")
    set(_gfx_sokol_default GLES3)
endif()
set(LMX_GRAPHICS_SOKOL_BACKEND "${_gfx_sokol_default}" CACHE STRING "Sokol renderer API: GLCORE, GLES3 or VULKAN")
set_property(CACHE LMX_GRAPHICS_SOKOL_BACKEND PROPERTY STRINGS GLCORE GLES3 VULKAN)
string(TOUPPER "${LMX_GRAPHICS_SOKOL_BACKEND}" _gfx_sokol_backend)
if(NOT _gfx_sokol_backend MATCHES "^(GLCORE|GLES3|VULKAN)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "LMX_GRAPHICS_SOKOL_BACKEND must select GLCORE, GLES3 or VULKAN")
endif()
if(NOT EMSCRIPTEN AND NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
endif()
function(_gfx_sokol_common target backend)
    lmx_c99_target(${target})
    target_include_directories(${target} PUBLIC "${_gfx_root}/include" "${_gfx_vendor}/sokol" "${_gfx_vendor}/sokol/util")
    target_compile_definitions(${target} PUBLIC SOKOL_${backend} PRIVATE _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L)
    if(TARGET Threads::Threads)
        target_link_libraries(${target} PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
    endif()
    if(UNIX OR MINGW)
        target_link_libraries(${target} PUBLIC m)
    endif()
    if(ANDROID)
        find_library(_gfx_android_log NAMES log REQUIRED)
        target_link_libraries(${target} PUBLIC "${_gfx_android_log}")
    endif()
endfunction()
add_library(lmx_graphics_sokol STATIC "${_gfx_root}/src/sokol_renderer.c" "${_gfx_root}/src/sokol_util.c")
add_library(LMX::sokol ALIAS lmx_graphics_sokol)
string(TOLOWER "${_gfx_sokol_backend}" _gfx_sokol_backend_lower)
add_library(LMX::sokol_${_gfx_sokol_backend_lower} ALIAS lmx_graphics_sokol)
_gfx_sokol_common(lmx_graphics_sokol "${_gfx_sokol_backend}")
if(WIN32)
    target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_sokol BEFORE PUBLIC "${_gfx_view}/sokol")
endif()
set_property(TARGET lmx_graphics_sokol PROPERTY INTERFACE_LMX_SOKOL_BACKEND "${_gfx_sokol_backend}")
set_property(TARGET lmx_graphics_sokol APPEND PROPERTY COMPATIBLE_INTERFACE_STRING LMX_SOKOL_BACKEND)
if(_gfx_sokol_backend STREQUAL "GLCORE")
    if(ANDROID OR EMSCRIPTEN OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "This platform uses GLES3 or VULKAN, not desktop GLCORE")
    elseif(APPLE)
        find_library(_gfx_opengl_framework NAMES OpenGL REQUIRED)
        target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_sokol PUBLIC "${_gfx_opengl_framework}")
    elseif(WIN32)
        # Upstream has an embedded Win32 OpenGL loader; no GLX/X11 linkage.
        target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_sokol PUBLIC kernel32)
    else()
        # GLVND's API library has no GLX/window-system link dependency.
        find_package(OpenGL REQUIRED COMPONENTS OpenGL)
        target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_sokol PUBLIC OpenGL::OpenGL)
    endif()
elseif(_gfx_sokol_backend STREQUAL "GLES3")
    if(EMSCRIPTEN OR CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
        target_link_options(lmx_graphics_sokol PUBLIC "-sUSE_WEBGL2=1")
    elseif(ANDROID)
        find_library(_gfx_gles_library NAMES GLESv3 REQUIRED)
        target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_sokol PUBLIC "${_gfx_gles_library}")
    elseif(APPLE)
        find_library(_gfx_gles_framework NAMES OpenGLES REQUIRED)
        target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_sokol PUBLIC "${_gfx_gles_framework}")
    else()
        find_path(_gfx_gles_include NAMES GLES3/gl32.h REQUIRED)
        find_library(_gfx_gles_library NAMES GLESv2 GLESv3 REQUIRED)
        target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_sokol PRIVATE "${_gfx_gles_include}")
        target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_sokol PUBLIC "${_gfx_gles_library}")
    endif()
elseif(_gfx_sokol_backend STREQUAL "VULKAN")
    find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_sokol PUBLIC Vulkan::Vulkan)
endif()
target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics INTERFACE lmx_graphics_sokol)
add_library(lmx_graphics_sokol_headers INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::sokol_headers ALIAS lmx_graphics_sokol_headers)
target_include_directories(lmx_graphics_sokol_headers INTERFACE "${_gfx_vendor}/sokol" "${_gfx_vendor}/sokol/util")

if(UNIX OR MINGW)
    foreach(_gfx_math IN ITEMS libspng olive nuklear sokol)
        if(TARGET lmx_graphics_${_gfx_math})
            target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_${_gfx_math} PUBLIC m)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

if(LMX_GRAPHICS_BUILD_TESTS)
    include("${_gfx_root}/Tests.cmake")
endif()
if(LMX_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
    add_executable(lmx_graphics_example "${_gfx_root}/examples/headless_draw.c")
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_graphics_example)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_graphics_example PRIVATE LMX::olive LMX::lodepng)
endif()
